name: LegalOS
long_description:
LegalOS is an AI-native immigration law firm that combines cutting-edge technology with 40+ years of legal expertise.

We’ve studied 12,000 successful petitions to design our process - which allows us to deliver top-quality visa applications in as quickly as 48 hours. Our specialized AI agents draft petition narratives, compile evidence, and anticipate USCIS objections - work that traditionally takes attorneys weeks, if not months.

Every case is reviewed and signed by licensed immigration attorneys with 40+ years of experience, so companies get both speed and reliability. We support O-1, H-1B, L-1A, L-1B, TN, EB-1A, EB-1C, and EB-2 NIW petitions.

Our unique approach works. We’ve filed dozens of visa applications and have a 100% approval rate so far.

The U.S. processes 1M+ work visas annually—a market where incumbents still operate on fax machines, email, and 1990s case management software. We're building the modern immigration law firm.

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio: Matthew is the co-founder and CEO of LegalOS. He previously founded the immigration SaaS Legal Bullet (Forbes 30 Under 30), and studied Astrophysics at the University of Chicago. Like his sister Rachel (COO), he grew up working in his family’s U.S. immigration law firm and now leads product and AI at LegalOS, turning 40+ years of immigration case data into automated, high-approval work-visa petitions.

founders.title: Founder/COO
founders.founder_bio: Rachel is the co-founder and COO of LegalOS. She double majored in Economics & Media Studies at the University of Chicago and previously managed 20+ A-list client deals at United Talent Agency, driving over $10M in tour revenue. She co-founded a charity that raised $70K for youth programs and grew up around her family’s U.S. immigration law firm. At LegalOS she owns operations and customer experience for companies and candidates using the platform.

founders.title: Founder/CTO
founders.founder_bio:
Claire is the co-founder and CTO of LegalOS. At LegalOS she leads engineering and AI, building the agents that power automated work-visa petitions.

She has an MS and BS in Computer Science from USC. She previously shipped LLM safety pipelines at TikTok that flag thousands of high-risk accounts daily, built document-classification models at Notarize and worked at NASA JPL on the Mars Exploration team.

launches.title: LegalOS - AI-Native Immigration Law Firm
launches.tagline: Get top-quality visa petitions in 48 hours, not months. We pair AI with 40 years of immigration expertise.
launches.body:
Hey everyone! 👋

We’re [Matthew](https://www.linkedin.com/in/matthew-asir), [Rachel](https://www.linkedin.com/in/rachelasir/), and [Claire](https://www.linkedin.com/in/clairejutabha/) – the founding team behind [LegalOS](https://legalos.ai?utm_source=yc&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=launch&utm_content=yc_launch).

### **TL;DR**

What if your immigration case moved as fast as you do?

We're an AI-native immigration law firm that combines AI with 40+ years of legal expertise. We’ve studied 12,000 successful petitions to design our process - which allows us to deliver top-quality visa applications in as quickly as 48 hours. 

Our unique approach works. We’ve filed dozens of visa applications and have a 100% approval rate so far.

**_Ask:_** If you are an international founder or a manager dealing with immigration? Email [help@legalos.ai](mailto:help@legalos.ai) or[ book a call with us](https://cal.com/rachelasir/legalos-consultation).

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KkhN4KHBXCU>

### **❌ The Problem**

Immigration law is broken - especially for startups

1. **Slow** - Traditional law firms take 6–8 weeks just to prepare a petition - burning runway and blocking hires
2. **Expensive** - Lawyers charge $10k-35k per visa, pricing out early-stage companies
3. **Black Box** - Founders & managers often have zero visibility into case progress until it's too late
4. **Unpredictable** - Inconsistent quality means RFEs, delays, and denials
5. **High Stakes -** A single denial can force a founder to leave the country or lose a critical engineer

Startups trying to make a critical hire simply can’t afford the cost, time, and uncertainty of traditional immigration firms.

### **✨ Our Solution**

LegalOS is a full service, AI-native immigration law firm. Our specialized AI agents that have been optimized on 12,000 winning petitions. _So far we have a 100% success rate._

**What we handle:**

* **O-1A/O-1B** (Extraordinary Ability)
* **EB-1A** (Alien of Extraordinary Ability)
* **EB-2 NIW** (National Interest Waiver)
* **EB-1C** (Multinational Managers)
* **H-1B, L-1A/B, TN** visas

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97014&key=user_uploads/2312887/0509d08d-fb8a-47c7-84c5-eae38ffb980e)

**How it works:**

1. **Intake**: Upload your docs, answer a few questions, and we have get your petition started in minutes
2. **AI-Powered Drafting**: Our agents build your petition using patterns from 12,000 successful cases
3. **Attorney Review**: An immigration attorney with 40+ years of experience reviews every filing

**Rapid Delivery**: You get a complete, filing-ready petition in as little as 48 hours - not weeks or months later

### **👫 The Team**

Rachel (COO) and Matthew (CEO) grew up in their family’s 40-year immigration law firm. We've watched thousands of cases, seen what makes petitions win or fail, and built LegalOS on that foundation.

Claire (CTO) brings the engineering talent – ex-TikTok, Notarize, and NASA JPL – and built the 24 specialized AI agents that power our platform.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97014&key=user_uploads/2312887/de9ef20d-b89c-4055-883c-f990382faa37)
